title: GHSL AI-agent index lists fork-artifact poisoning in SPIFFE SPIRE reviewer workflow
ai_system: GitHub Security Lab AI agent (system not named in advisory)
summary: An artifact produced by a fork-controlled workflow can overwrite a trusted JavaScript helper in the privileged consumer workspace; the consumer imports and executes that helper before validating artifact data.
ai_role: GHSL’s primary AI-agent index lists this advisory among findings discovered with AI agents. The item advisory credits Jaroslav Lobačevski but does not name an AI system or detail agent involvement; attribution is index-level only.
classification_note: The report describes an attack path and remediation; no exploitation in the wild is claimed.
remediation_note: A fix pull request was merged 2026-09-04. The advisory notes that fork workflow approval policy may be required, but no approving review is needed in the described pull-request path.

impacts.conditions: Attacker-controlled fork artifact is extracted into a trusted-code workspace; source describes replacement of executable workflow code.
impacts.exploitation: The cited source does not state whether this issue was exploited in the wild.
